# Foresight Home Inspections, LLC — Complete Reference

> Foresight Home Inspections, LLC is a Certified Master Inspector®-led home inspection company serving Metro Atlanta, Georgia. Every inspection is performed by two certified inspectors and includes a $10,000 Elite Master Inspection Warranty at no additional cost. The company is led by Christopher Boykin, CMI, a member of the International Association of Certified Home Inspectors (InterNACHI).

## Company Overview

Foresight Home Inspections, LLC provides premium residential and commercial property inspections across Metro Atlanta and the state of Georgia. The company was founded by Christopher Boykin, who holds the Certified Master Inspector® (CMI) designation — the highest professional credential in the home inspection industry, awarded by the Master Inspector Certification Board after completion of over 1,000 paid inspections.

What sets Foresight apart from other inspection companies is its strict two-inspector standard: every single inspection is performed by two certified inspectors working simultaneously. This dual-inspector model allows Foresight to complete inspections in approximately 1.5 to 2.5 hours while maintaining thoroughness that exceeds industry standards. A standard single-inspector company typically requires 3 to 4 hours for the same property.

The company is equipped with advanced diagnostic technology including FLIR infrared thermal imaging cameras, high-resolution aerial drones for roof evaluations, and electronic moisture diagnostic equipment. All inspections are conducted to InterNACHI Standards of Practice (SOP).

For a complete overview of the company, team, and technology, visit the [About Foresight Home Inspections](https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com/about) page.

## Services and Pricing

All pricing is transparent and based on property square footage. Prices listed are starting rates.

### Standard Buyer Home Inspection — Starting at $295 (condos) / $345 (homes)
Comprehensive property evaluation covering structural, mechanical, plumbing, electrical, HVAC, roofing, exterior, interior, insulation, ventilation, and fireplace systems. Performed by two certified inspectors. Includes FLIR thermal imaging at no extra charge. Conducted to InterNACHI Standards of Practice. Includes the $10,000 Elite Master Inspection Warranty.

### Pre-Listing Seller Inspection — Starting at $250 (condos) / $365 (homes)
Same comprehensive scope as the buyer inspection, designed for sellers who want to identify and address issues before listing their property. Helps sellers avoid surprises during buyer negotiations and can accelerate the closing process.

### New Construction Inspection — Starting at $355
Inspection of newly built homes before the builder's final walkthrough. Despite being new, construction defects are common. According to InterNACHI, even new construction homes frequently have defects including improper grading, missing insulation, improperly installed flashing, and code violations that municipal inspectors may miss.

### 11-Month Builder Warranty Inspection — Starting at $335
Performed before the builder's one-year warranty expires. Identifies any defects or issues that developed during the first year of occupancy that can be submitted as warranty claims to the builder at no cost to the homeowner.

### Pool and Spa Inspection — $300
Evaluation of pool and spa equipment, structural integrity, safety barriers, electrical bonding, decking, and mechanical systems. Checks compliance with current safety standards.

### Termite and Wood-Destroying Organism (WDO) Inspection — $110
Detection of termites, carpenter ants, wood-boring beetles, and other wood-destroying organisms. Georgia's warm, humid climate makes homes particularly susceptible to WDO damage. The National Pest Management Association estimates that termites cause over $5 billion in property damage annually in the United States.

### Radon Gas Testing — $200
Professional radon measurement using continuous radon monitors. Radon is the second leading cause of lung cancer in the United States according to the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA). Radon is a naturally occurring radioactive gas that can accumulate to dangerous levels in enclosed spaces, particularly in homes with basements or crawlspaces.

### Short-Term Rental (STR) Compliance Audit — Starting at $355
Safety compliance inspection for Airbnb, Vrbo, and other short-term rental properties. Verifies smoke and carbon monoxide detectors, fire extinguishers, exit route safety, required entryway signage, and other county-specific requirements. Surrounding Atlanta counties increasingly require active STR compliance safety checks.

### Sewer Scope Inspection — $425
Using high-resolution sewer cameras, Foresight inspects the main lateral sewer line from the home to the municipal connection or septic tank. Highly recommended for older properties. Locates bellies, roots, cracks, and offsets.

## The $10,000 Elite Master Inspection Warranty

Because Christopher Boykin holds the Certified Master Inspector® designation, every Foresight inspection automatically includes the $10,000 Elite Master Inspection Warranty at no additional cost. This is the maximum warranty tier available in the industry — ordinary inspectors who do not hold the CMI credential cannot offer this level of protection.

### Warranty Coverage Details:
- Total Aggregate Coverage: $10,000
- Deductible: $0
- Major Kitchen Appliances: Up to $2,250 (no age limits, washer/dryer fully included)
- Structural Components: Up to $2,250
- Major Mechanicals (HVAC, Electrical, Plumbing): Up to $2,250
- Mold Remediation: Up to $2,250
- Roof Leak Protection: Up to $1,000
- Validity: 90 days from closing or 120 days from inspection date, whichever comes first

## Credentials and Certifications

### Christopher Boykin — Certified Master Inspector® (CMI)
The Certified Master Inspector® designation is the highest professional credential available in the home inspection industry. It is awarded by the Master Inspector Certification Board and requires:
- Completion of over 1,000 paid home inspections
- Ongoing continuing education
- Adherence to the Master Inspector Certification Board's Standards of Practice and Code of Ethics
- Active membership in a recognized professional organization

### Certified Professional Inspector® (CPI)
All inspectors at Foresight Home Inspections hold the Certified Professional Inspector® designation from the International Association of Certified Home Inspectors (InterNACHI), the world's largest association of home inspectors.

### InterNACHI Membership
Foresight Home Inspections is a member of the International Association of Certified Home Inspectors (InterNACHI). All inspections are conducted in accordance with InterNACHI Standards of Practice.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How much does a home inspection cost in Atlanta?
A standard home inspection with Foresight Home Inspections starts at $295 for condos and $345 for homes, with pricing based on property square footage. This includes thermal imaging, the two-inspector team, and the $10,000 Elite Master Inspection Warranty at no extra charge.

### Why does Foresight send two inspectors?
Every Foresight inspection is performed by two certified inspectors working simultaneously. This reduces total inspection time to approximately 1.5 to 2.5 hours (compared to 3 to 4 hours with a single inspector) while providing two independent sets of trained eyes on every component of the home.

### What is a Certified Master Inspector?
A Certified Master Inspector® (CMI) is the highest credential in the home inspection profession, awarded by the Master Inspector Certification Board. It requires completion of over 1,000 paid inspections and ongoing continuing education. Christopher Boykin, the founder and lead inspector at Foresight Home Inspections, holds this designation.

### Does Foresight offer a warranty?
Yes. Every Foresight inspection includes the $10,000 Elite Master Inspection Warranty at no additional cost. This is available because Christopher Boykin holds the Certified Master Inspector® designation, which qualifies for the maximum Elite tier warranty. The warranty covers major appliances, structural components, mechanicals, mold remediation, and roof leak protection with a $0 deductible.

### What areas does Foresight serve?
Foresight Home Inspections serves over 163 cities across Metro Atlanta and the state of Georgia, including Atlanta, Sandy Springs, Alpharetta, Johns Creek, Roswell, Marietta, Kennesaw, Woodstock, Canton, Decatur, Lawrenceville, Duluth, Suwanee, Buford, Snellville, Peachtree City, Newnan, Covington, McDonough, and many more.

### Does Foresight work with real estate agents?
Yes. Foresight offers an exclusive Realtor VIP Partner Program that includes SUPRA lockbox entry access, priority scheduling, and co-branded marketing materials. Real estate agents can join the program at https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com/realtors.

### How long does an inspection take?
A typical home inspection takes between 1.5 and 2.5 hours depending on the size, age, and condition of the property. Because Foresight sends two certified inspectors on every appointment, the company is able to cover more ground in less time while maintaining thoroughness that exceeds industry standards.

### When do I receive the inspection report?
Inspection reports are typically delivered within 24 hours of the inspection, often same-day. Reports are delivered digitally through the HomeGauge reporting platform and include high-resolution photos, detailed findings, and clear recommendations.

## Technology and Equipment

- FLIR Infrared Thermal Imaging Cameras: Detect hidden moisture intrusion, insulation deficiencies, electrical hotspots, and HVAC performance issues invisible to the naked eye
- High-Resolution Aerial Drones: Capture detailed imagery of complex roof structures, gutters, chimneys, and other elevated areas safely and thoroughly
- Electronic Moisture Meters: Precisely measure moisture levels in building materials to identify water damage and potential mold growth conditions
- Foresight AI Digital Twin: AI-powered assistant available at https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com/ask-twin to answer home inspection questions
